description: Sentences for what DECtalk's letter-to-sound does with text its command parser has rewritten: a percent sign and other symbols standing alone, e-mail and web addresses, an ellipsis, nested quotes, a clock time before a word, a degree written with periods, and clauses of more than 300 characters. Written before any export and not edited afterwards.

The old man who lived in the small white house beside the river walked every morning to the bakery at the far end of the village where he bought two loaves of brown bread and a jar of honey for his sister who was too ill to leave her bed and who waited for him by the window with a cup of tea that had long since gone cold

When the children came home from school that afternoon they found the kitchen door open and the dog asleep on the step and a strange green bicycle leaning against the wall of the shed and none of them could say whose it was or how long it had been there or why the dog had not barked at whoever had left it and gone away again without a word to anyone in the house or the garden or the lane behind the church where their father was working on the roof of the barn with his two brothers.
